section_summary.extract_value: This conclusion section discusses that positive body image, specifically body appreciation, may be linked to greater sexual liberalism and positive attitudes towards unconventional sex. It suggests that if these results are replicated, they could inform practitioners working on body image and sexuality within a sex-positive framework, promoting improved sexual and psychological well-being.
section_summary.evidence_source: The present results suggest that positive body image, and particularly body appreciation, may be associated with greater sexual liberalism and more positive attitudes toward unconventional sex.
